does: Rolls one die plus a bonus on the Generic stream through the roll manager's plain dice roll, with no boosts: the initiative die of a combatant.

evidence.says: As a fight of three began, three d4 were thrown from +0x32019E1 inside this function, one with the bonus a pinned initiative gives and two with a goblin's
It takes the manager's generic stream and calls the plain dice roll
EoCServer.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
